dr.signIn.useYourAfrotransactStaffAccoun: Use your AfroTransact staff account. You need the “Use the driver app” permission.
dr.index.noRouteOnThisPhone: No route on this phone yet
dr.index.defectSentToDispatchA: Defect sent to dispatch — a replacement vehicle will be assigned. You can’t start this route.
dr.index.routeStarted: Route started — tap “I’ve arrived” when you get there
dr.profile.paused: Paused — actions queue on this phone
dr.profile.noSignal: No signal — actions queue on this phone
dr.sos.notified: Dispatch notified — they’ll call you now. Remaining stops can be reassigned.
dr.sos.queued: No signal — SOS will send the moment you’re back online. Call 911 if you’re in danger.
dr.sos.failed: Couldn’t raise SOS. Call dispatch or 911.
dr.crash.title: Something went wrong
dr.crash.body: The app hit an unexpected problem. Your queued actions are safe on this phone.
dr.profile.rtlRestart: Arabic uses a right-to-left layout; it applies the next time the app opens.
dr.mfa.title: Two-step verification
dr.mfa.totpTitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.
dr.mfa.smsTitle: Enter the 6-digit code we texted to {hint}.
dr.mfa.recoveryTitle: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each works once.
dr.mfa.trust: Don’t ask again on this phone
dr.signIn.heroAlt: A courier in a gold vest hands a parcel to a customer at their door
dr.signIn.helpLine: Locked out or need an account? Contact dispatch.
dr.signIn.demoAccounts:
Driver: tunde@afrotransact.com
Ops admin with driver access: daniel@afrotransact.com
No driver access: kofi@afrotransact.com
Two-step: an email starting with “mfa”, code 123456
Rate limit: password “limit”
dr.signIn.err.credentials: The email or password is incorrect. Check them and try again.
dr.signIn.err.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {time}.
dr.signIn.err.rateLimitedNoTime: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
dr.signIn.err.expired: This sign-in expired. Enter your email and password again.
dr.signIn.err.offline: Can’t reach AfroTransact. Check your connection and try again.
dr.signIn.err.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
dr.mfa.err.invalidCode: That code is incorrect or has expired. Check it and try again.
dr.mfa.trustHint: Skip this step on this phone next time. AfroTransact decides for how long and may still ask again.
dr.noAccess.reasonDenied: {email} is signed in but doesn’t have driver access.
dr.noAccess.reasonRevoked: Your driver access was just removed by an administrator.
dr.noAccess.askDispatch: Ask dispatch to add the Driver role, then sign in again.
dr.noAccess.unsyncedOne: {count} unsynced event is kept on this phone. It is sent as soon as the phone is online and you’re signed in.
dr.noAccess.unsyncedMany: {count} unsynced events are kept on this phone. They are sent as soon as the phone is online and you’re signed in.
dr.lock.unsentStay: Unsent updates stay on this phone and sync when you sign in again.
dr.lock.lockedOut: Too many wrong passcodes. Sign in with your password. Unsent updates are kept on this phone.
dr.lock.faceIdBody: Open the app and you’re straight in, without typing. Your face stays on this phone, and your passcode is always the fallback.
dr.lock.faceIdFailed: {method} isn’t available or wasn’t confirmed. Try again, or continue with a passcode only.
dr.lock.passcodeBody: It unlocks the app after it has been in the background, and when biometrics aren’t available.
dr.lock.issueRepeating: Too easy to guess. Don’t repeat one digit.
dr.lock.issueMismatch: The passcodes didn’t match. Start again.
dr.profile.biometricHint: Open the app with your face or fingerprint. The passcode is always the fallback.
dr.profile.biometricUnavailable: {method} isn’t set up on this phone.
